lines.text: Hezekiah became mortally ill, so he prayed to the LORD, who spoke to him and gave him a sign.
Because his heart was proud, wrath came upon Hezekiah, Judah and Jerusalem, until he and the people humbled themselves.
Hezekiah blocked the upper outlet of the Spring of Kidron and channeled it down to the west side of the City of David.
Ambassadors from the rulers of Egypt came to ask about the wonder in the land, and God left Hezekiah alone to test him.
Hezekiah was buried in the upper tombs of David's descendants, all Judah honored him, and his son Manasseh reigned.
